attributes.title: FLASHA 2027 Annual Convention
attributes.venue: Hilton Lake Buena Vista Disney Springs
attributes.organizer: Florida Association of Speech-Language Pathologists and Audiologists
attributes.summary: FLASHA holds its 2027 Annual Convention on June 16-19, 2027, at the Hilton Lake Buena Vista Disney Springs in Orlando. The in-person program for SLPs, audiologists, assistants and students is supplemented by pre-recorded virtual sessions available from June 20 to July 20. Attendees receive certificates of completion for the sessions they attend.
